title: Vending Services Program Commission Rates, Thresholds and Payout Frequency
content:
Commission paid back to the client under the Vending Services Program is set by four figures printed against the programme the agreement is written at: the commission percentage of gross machine sales, the monthly sales a machine must reach before commission accrues on it, the smallest commission paid out in one statement period, and how often and how long after the period closes commission is paid.

| Programme | Commission percentage of gross machine sales | Monthly sales a machine must reach before commission accrues | Smallest commission paid out in one statement period | Payout frequency | Calendar days after the period closes by which commission is paid |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | 5.00 | 320.00 | 15.00 | quarterly | 45 |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | 7.50 | 420.00 | 25.00 | quarterly | 45 |
| Combination Vending Bank | 10.00 | 560.00 | 40.00 | monthly | 30 |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | 8.00 | 720.00 | 55.00 | monthly | 30 |
| Campus Vending Network Service | 12.00 | 500.00 | 180.00 | monthly | 21 |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | 6.00 | 800.00 | 120.00 | monthly | 21 |

Percentages are percentages of gross machine sales; money figures are in US dollars; the payout lag is counted in calendar days. The sales figure is a per-machine monthly figure; the smallest payout figure is an amount for one statement period.

### The schedule restated by column

Two of the six programmes pay commission quarterly and four pay it monthly. The payout lag runs at 45 calendar days on the two quarterly programmes, at 30 on the Combination Vending Bank and the Fresh Food Vending Service, and at 21 on the Campus Vending Network Service and the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service. The commission percentage does not rise in step with the size of the programme: the highest percentage in the schedule, 12.00, belongs to the Campus Vending Network Service, while the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service carries the lowest but one at 6.00 and the Single Machine Snack Service the lowest at 5.00.

### Points of judgement on the figures

The per-machine sales figure and the payout figure answer different questions. The first is stated against a machine and a month, so it is read machine by machine: on the Combination Vending Bank it is 560.00 of monthly sales on a machine. The second is stated against one statement period for the estate as a whole: on the same programme it is 40.00 of commission. The percentage figure says what share of gross machine sales the commission is, and the lag figure says how many calendar days may pass after a statement period closes before the commission for that period is paid.
